requirements.description: The user prefers a property in energy class D or better, so all classes from D up to A1 are included.
User wants the unit located near parks. Per the 'near' rule, the threshold is the green 75th percentile (74.26), rounded to 74.
The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area, which maps directly to the surface_area column.

output.explanation: Filters commercial-type properties (property_type exact match) with surface_area >= 115 sqm, within 3.0 km of the given coordinates (haversine on latitude/longitude), energy class A1 through D, and green score >= 74. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates, nearest first. No requirements were added beyond those extracted.
